description: Two numbered frames. In frame 1 the editor soft-wraps line 19 (a long raise): the continuation has no line number of its own. It is kept as its own line right after line 19 with the soft_wrap flag, and word_wrap is emitted once for frame 1 (frame 1 also sets word_wrap_detected; one event per frame) (REQ-STI-09). The output equals the source except that line 19 is split in two.
